method: scripts/quality/audit-long-bodies.py seeds long-body content and renders the body screen at up to three text scales on clara-bw-391. CJK probes run twice: once with the default face set, where the debug simulator must halt on the undrawable-character contract, and once with KOBO_READING_FONT aimed at the bundled CobaltJapanese face, the path that makes CJK drawable.

cases.vault-long-body: pass: 7.7k-char accented note paginated cleanly at default, large and extra-large
cases.needles-long-pattern: pass: 3000-row pattern; counter screen and sectioning render at default and extra-large
cases.parser-long-story: pass: real zork1 story paginated at 3 scales (parser-repro matrix, 27 combos)
cases.vault-cjk-default: pass: Japanese note body halts the debug simulator, exactly the undrawable-character contract; on a panel the same text would draw as boxes, so CJK notes are unsupported in Vault by platform design
cases.vault-cjk-japanese-face: pass: the same note renders fully in Japanese when the reading face covers it (KOBO_READING_FONT=CobaltJapanese), proving the override path

fonts.text: Atkinson Hyperlegible Regular+Bold, bundled; covers accented Latin; CJK outside coverage by design
fonts.mono: DejaVu Sans Mono, bundled; fixed-pitch widgets (terminal rows, hashes); coverage enforced by kobo-ui check_text_coverage
fonts.reading: discovered serif: Bitter then Vollkorn on device; falls back to the interface face when no serif exists; KOBO_READING_FONT overrides (proven with CobaltJapanese)
fonts.publisher: flashcards installs CobaltJapanese-Regular.otf and selects it per card via card_text_font; covered by the app unit tests (install_fonts, Japanese deck screens)
